title: 国際教養理工学特別科目（ＰＤ　Ⅰｎｎｏｖａｔｉｏｎ）（夏期集中講義）
courseType: （全課程からの提供）リベラルアーツ系科目文理横断
educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
This course will provide learners the basic concept of innovation, and why we need
innovation capacity as required in our future society. Students identify and solve
problems or challenges in a logical, scientific, and creative way to commercialize
a business idea.
The course focuses on exploring how feasible the business idea can be.
advice:
In the course, students work in groups and individually, developing skills in teamwork
to create value of creative ideas.
1. The five disciplines of innovation of Stanford Research Institute (SRI) will be utilized and
  demonstrated through the lessons.
2. The course uses the SRI's NABC framework (Needs - Approach - Benefits/Costs - Competition) as
  the backbone of the course in describing and expressing the value proposition of innovative
  business ideas.
3. The value of the innovation projects will be continuously added through the Value Creation
  Forum (VCF).
4. The propositions are also expressed through the Project Design Model Canvas (PDMC) to provide
  customers / stakeholders the best overview of the project.

              This course will provide learners the basic concept of innovation, and why we need
innovation capacity as required in our future society. Students identify and solve
problems or challenges in a logical, scientific, and creative way to commercialize
a business idea.
The course focuses on exploring how feasible the business idea can be.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In the course, students work in groups and individually, developing skills in teamwork
to create value of creative ideas.
1. The five disciplines of innovation of Stanford Research Institute (SRI) will be utilized and
  demonstrated through the lessons.
2. The course uses the SRI's NABC framework (Needs - Approach - Benefits/Costs - Competition) as
  the backbone of the course in describing and expressing the value proposition of innovative
  business ideas.
3. The value of the innovation projects will be continuously added through the Value Creation
  Forum (VCF).
4. The propositions are also expressed through the Project Design Model Canvas (PDMC) to provide
  customers / stakeholders the best overview of the project.
